spans.s:
The affix इनि (इन्) comes in the sense of 'by him' after इष्ट etc.

Terms: इनि (इन्)

For the long vowel a short is substituted in इष्टका before चित in इषीका before तूल and in माला before भारिन्।

Terms: Shortening

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the Absolutive इष्ट्वीनम् is irregularly formed for इष्ट्वा।

Terms: छन्दस् substitution
